summary: @servicetitan/ld-type-generator ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727 KB bundle
details: The package declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` — a 727 KB obfuscator.io-shaped compiled Bun bundle (int/string array plus rotator) — at `npm install` time. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated with `_0xNNNN` identifier renaming and string-indirection tables, deliberately concealing what runs. The advertised CLI (dist/cli.js) is a ~60-line utility that fetches LaunchDarkly flag metadata via axios and writes a TypeScript file; it has no functional relationship to Bun or to the 727 KB init bundle. Routing execution through Bun rather than Node also prevents Node-based tooling on the installer host from inspecting the payload. This shape — alternate-runtime dropper executing an opaque, obfuscated bundle at install time whose behavior is disjoint from the package's advertised purpose — is a supply-chain dropper, not a legitimate native-runtime install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
